entities.name: Medev
entities.description: A Neurok settlement of tin on the shores of the Quicksilver Sea of Mirrodin, ruled by Bruenna.

entities.name: Bruenna
entities.description: Mage and leader of Medev who aided Glissa and later fled to the Tangle.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: An elf who arrived in Medev with Slobad and Bosh.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: Goblin who arrived in Medev with Glissa.

entities.name: Bosh
entities.description: Iron golem who arrived in Medev with Glissa.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The being who destroyed Medev in anger.

entities.name: Pontifex
entities.description: Vedalken whose death disrupted Memnarch's plans.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: People of Medev enslaved by the vedalken.

entities.name: Quicksilver Sea
entities.description: Sea on Mirrodin where Medev stands.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: Place to which Bruenna smuggled the heroes.

events.summary: Glissa, Slobad and Bosh arrived in Medev and tried to get information from Bruenna, who saw through them.
events.quote: When Glissa , Slobad , and Bosh arrived in Medev

events.summary: Aerophin attacked Medev; Bruenna and Glissa fought them, and Bruenna smuggled the heroes to Lumengrid on a metal tank.
events.quote: The village was then attacked by aerophin

events.summary: Bruenna helped stop Pontifex, leading to his death and disrupting Memnarch's plans to ascend.
events.quote: Bruenna was partly responsible for stopping Pontifex

events.summary: Memnarch sent levelers and aerophins to destroy Medev, killing all inhabitants but Bruenna, who fled to the Tangle.
events.quote: destroying the village and killing all its inhabitants save Bruenna herself

relations.note: The Vedalken enslaved the Neurok people.
relations.quote: enslaving the Neurok people to work for the Vedalken Empire

relations.note: He destroyed her village after earning his ire.
